subject: Nova Bank — procurement & onboarding steps (post-call recap)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditi Sharma <aditi.sharma@novabank.com>, Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@novabank.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Nova Bank — procurement & onboarding steps (post-call recap)

Hi Aditi / Carlos —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the agreed next steps so we have alignment on procurement and onboarding: 

Summary of needs:
- Pilot: 6-month pilot for customer support routing + redaction, multi-region (US primary)
- Expected QPS: 120 peak, average 35
- Data controls: VPC + KMS, audit logs for queries

Key decision criteria you called out:
- Security (SOC2, KMS integration)
- Predictable latency under load
- Clear PO/invoicing terms and cost transparency

Immediate action items we committed to: 
1) I’ll share a draft SOW + vendor onboarding checklist for your procurement team (attached).
2) Rishi will follow up with finance on billing/PO options and standard payment terms.
3) You’ll loop in procurement/legal to confirm any additional evidence they need (security questionnaire, SOC2 report).

Attachments: NovaBank_SOW_Draft_v1.pdf (SOW draft), vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx

Could you confirm the procurement contact who will own PO issuance and preferred net terms (Net 30/45/60)? Also please confirm if a vendor form is required and estimated procurement SLA for onboarding. 

Next cadence: I’ll check back Thursday to see procurement status and any blockers.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0182

Subject: Re: Nova Bank — procurement & onboarding steps (post-call recap)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the summary — that looks right. Looping in procurement (procurement@novabank.com) to pick up the onboarding checklist and confirm process. Procurement note: we generally require a vendor form and our standard W-9; we also ask for SOC2 Type II attestation or equivalent.

PO timing: typical internal procurement window is 3–4 weeks once legal signs off on the SOW. We can sometimes expedite to 10 business days for pilots if needed (requires approval from Finance).

Procurement contact: Carlos Mendes (copied) will own the PO and vendor setup. Carlos — can you confirm the payment terms Nova prefers?

Aditi
Aditi Sharma
Head of Engineering — Customer Experience
Nova Bank
aditi.sharma@novabank.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nova Bank — procurement & onboarding steps (post-call recap)

Thanks for looping us in, Aditi. A few clarifications from finance/ops side: 

- We can accept Net 30 or Net 45 by default. Net 60 requires approval and a credit check for new enterprise customers.
- For pilots, we can offer upfront invoice for the first month and then monthly invoices thereafter if that helps accelerate procurement.
- Vendor setup: we’ll need the completed vendor form + W-9 (or equivalent). For SOC2 evidence, we can provide the latest SOC2 Type II report under NDA or via secure portal — happy to start that process now.

I’ve attached a short checklist (vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx) and marked the fields procurement typically asks for. If Carlos can confirm the vendor form link or portal and the target PO date, we’ll prepare the SOW revision and billing terms.

Cheers,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Nova Bank — procurement & onboarding steps (post-call recap)

Hi Carlos / Procurement team —

Following up on Rishi and Aditi’s notes. To keep the pilot timeline targeted for a May 10th kickoff, ideally we’d have vendor setup and PO in place by May 3rd (gives infra team one week to provision Dedicated capacity + KMS).

Action items for procurement: 
- Confirm preferred payment terms (Net 30/45) and whether Net 60 is needed.
- Share vendor form link or portal instructions and expected date for completed vendor form + W-9.
- Confirm whether SOC2 report will be accepted under NDA or if additional questionnaires are required.

From Redwood: we’ll upload SOC2 Type II to your secure portal or execute an NDA if needed; we’ll revise the SOW to reflect pilot start date and deliverables once PO timeline is confirmed.

If it helps, we’re happy to have a quick 15-min call with procurement this week to walk through the checklist and SOW items. What time Friday afternoon or Monday morning works best?

Thanks,
Marissa
